prototype-windowed
==================

Requirement: PrototypeFix 1.8 must already be installed.

1. Copy prototype_windowed.asi and Install_PrototypeWindowed.bat to the game folder.
2. Run Install_PrototypeWindowed.bat once.
3. Launch Prototype normally.

The original prototype_fix.asi is not renamed or replaced.
The installer only updates prototype_fix.ini and creates a backup.
